execution.source: unmeasured allocations: observer then FOC; guard is reserved slack, not additional execution

engineering_profile.separation: Plant parameters and observer estimates are independent fields. No truth angle, speed, motor state or true terminal voltage enters estimation. No perfect inverse of ADC clipping or lost samples.

time_semantics.reference_time: JEOS; three aperture times remain distinct; alignment must be causal and implemented in N3R1
time_semantics.UEV_write_tie: UEV wins; a coincident new write waits for the next allowed UEV
time_semantics.durations: ceil to native ticks, never shorten programmed deadtime/execution; recorded effective values
time_semantics.guard: write strictly before intended UEV minus guard; equality fails admission
time_semantics.angle_outputs: sample-reference angle, publication/query-time angle, and PWM-apply angle are separate; no one extra omega*Ts correction for all paths
time_semantics.phase_policy: causal estimated frequency and declared filter models only; no truth fitting; observer filter and measurement-chain delay counted separately once

performance_requirements.false_valid_target_basis: new engineering acceptance target, not measured plant limit; failure stays failure and cannot be relaxed after observing results
performance_requirements.hard_fault_control_permission: ADC invalid/rail, failed timing admission, inconsistent timestamp/sequence, or stale packet revokes permission at the first supervisor call; raw values may remain diagnostic only
performance_requirements.low_speed_200rpm_and_stop: not an accuracy target; deny control permission, report raw values and loss/recovery; separate startup/low-speed method required
performance_requirements.saturation_and_bus_profile: no arbitrary magnetic curve or calibrated bus-error claim; absent measurements remain explicit unvalidated items

integrated_matrix.requirements: separate 200rpm/stop, missing-five and one-reset traces; do not merge events to hide a failure

replay_and_regression: every final integrated trace independently rerun in a fresh process; complete raw Time/Data isequaln; original52 compared with observer-absent same plant/measurement/timing configuration; v1 evidence remains separate
failure_policy: preserve attempts and source; at most one retry per new-version case for explicit native 0xc0000005/0xc000001d; never retry numerical failures into a pass
model_preservation: original SLX, motor/PI reference and four v1 contracts remain byte-identical; injection/adapters live in dev sensorless and are removable; user-open GUI session is not modified
unvalidated_hardware_items: real bus ripple and bus measurement error
